name: Hands-On Holidays and Hotcakes at the Akron Children's Museum
when_note: Sunday, December 6, three sessions from 9:15 AM, museum closes at 3 PM
paras: The Akron Children's Museum, 216 S Main St, turns a December Sunday into a hotcake breakfast and a day of holiday play. Hands-On Holidays and Hotcakes runs on Sunday, December 6, with the museum closing at 3 PM.

Families check in and head to the Holiday Hotcake Hall for a buffet of fluffy pancakes, a toppings bar, coffee and drinks. When everyone has eaten, special holiday guests announce play time and the group moves into the museum.
Inside, kids make and take holiday crafts, get their faces painted, try hands-on STEM activities and meet Santa and friends. Tickets are sold online in advance for one of three sessions.
tip: Pick a session when you buy tickets, since families move from the dining space to the museum with their belongings.

name: Paws and Claus Photos with Santa at Twinkle Nights
when_note: Saturday, December 19 and Sunday, December 20, 6 to 9 PM
cost: Free photos with Santa; tickets for the light show ride sold online
paras: Santa Claus moves indoors this year at Twinkle Nights, the Family Resource Center's drive-thru Christmas light show at the Hancock County Fairgrounds, 1017 E Sandusky St in Findlay. Paws and Claus runs Saturday, December 19 and Sunday, December 20, from 6 to 9 PM.
Kids, pets or the whole crew can stop for free photos with Santa and then take a ride through the lights. Tickets for the ride are sold online.
The host is also collecting wishlist items for the Humane Society and SPCA of Hancock County. Guests who bring an item to donate receive a free beverage from Travelin' Tom's Coffee.
tip: Bring a wishlist item for the Humane Society to get a free coffee or cocoa from Travelin' Tom's.
